source: Original PDF project titles and stage positions; use-case/control details are Academy teaching design

projects.title: Professional Digital Twin Agent
projects.status: planned portfolio; inspect project evidence before claiming completion
projects.intendedUser: Career information approved by the fictional portfolio owner
projects.humanApproval: Approve contact delivery and any newly added claims
projects.limitation: Never invent qualifications or private contact details

projects.title: AI Sales Development Team
projects.status: planned portfolio; inspect project evidence before claiming completion
projects.limitation: No unsolicited real outreach in the course practical

projects.title: Deep Research Intelligence Team
projects.status: planned portfolio; inspect project evidence before claiming completion
projects.intendedUser: A researcher comparing a bounded topic
projects.output: A sourced report distinguishing findings and uncertainty
projects.humanApproval: Review source quality and report before publication
projects.limitation: A fluent report is not evidence that its claims are correct

projects.title: Market Intelligence and Stock Screening Crew
projects.status: planned portfolio; inspect project evidence before claiming completion
projects.intendedUser: A student applying transparent screening rules
projects.humanApproval: Review data date, assumptions and limitations
projects.limitation: Educational examples; no investment advice or promised returns

projects.title: Sandboxed AI Engineering Team
projects.status: planned portfolio; inspect project evidence before claiming completion
projects.intendedUser: A developer implementing a small specification
projects.output: Source changes and actual isolated test results
projects.humanApproval: Approve changes before merging or deployment
projects.limitation: A sandbox is one control, not permission to run arbitrary host actions

projects.title: Browser Task Sidekick
projects.status: planned portfolio; inspect project evidence before claiming completion
projects.intendedUser: An operator performing a bounded browser task
projects.output: A resumable task record and approval-held sensitive actions
projects.humanApproval: Approve submission, purchase, deletion and other sensitive actions
projects.limitation: Use course-owned pages; do not automate private accounts

projects.title: Agent Application Factory
projects.status: planned portfolio; inspect project evidence before claiming completion
projects.intendedUser: A developer producing an app from a typed request
projects.output: Generated application source with actual tests
projects.humanApproval: Review generated code and deployment configuration
projects.limitation: Generated source is not automatically production-ready

projects.title: MCP-Powered AI Trading Floor
projects.status: planned portfolio; inspect project evidence before claiming completion
projects.intendedUser: A student studying service-connected research and simulation
projects.humanApproval: Approve simulated orders; live broker execution is outside this course practical
projects.limitation: Paper trading only; no live orders, financial promises or fabricated executions
